original_fragments.exact_quote: Pelvic MRI confirmed a locally advanced rectal tumor (cT3N2,
MRF-, EMVI+): a semicircular tumor predominantly in the middle
rectum, extending into the lower rectum and marginally into the
upper rectum; the mesorectal fascia was not affected, extramural
venous invasion and numerous pelvic lymph nodes were present
(Figure 1a).
